package: Qpocket quantum data and final numeric results
historical_code_scope: The repository commit identifies the accompanying checkout. It does not establish the exact historical hardware implementation.

accompanying_SI.title: Supporting Information for Quantum-Guided Ensemble Generation for Accurate Drug-Binding Pocket Prediction: Application to KRAS

public_job_identifiers: job_0001 through job_0591 are consistent archive-local pseudonyms, not IBM Runtime IDs. The provider-ID mapping is excluded.
retention_scope: Quantum scientific metadata and source-file-order raw count excerpts; other scientific data restricted to final numeric tables. Private execution metadata and intermediate structural/scoring records excluded.

raw_count_excerpt.selection_unit: one saved bitstring/count entry, not one individual shot
raw_count_excerpt.selection_order: source-file circuit-list order followed by stored count-entry order; no sorting
raw_count_excerpt.individual_shot_order: not recorded in the saved source format; not reconstructed
raw_count_excerpt.source_value_handling: bitstrings and integer counts copied without expansion, reweighting or normalization
raw_count_excerpt.truncation: Selection may cut a source circuit's count table. Every retained count remains its frequency in the original complete circuit result.
raw_count_excerpt.ordered_hash_encoding: For each CSV row in sequence: circuit_index_0based TAB entry_index_1based TAB bitstring TAB count LF, ASCII, SHA-256.
